body.p: Detailed Claim ListingThis listing of claims will replace all prior versions, and listings, of claims in the application.

br.br:
1. (Currently Amended) A robotic surgical device comprising:(a) an elongate component configured to be gjeagg~xria~v positionable in to a body cavity of a patient such that a distal portion of the elongate component is positioned within the body cavity and a proximal portion of the elongate component is positioned outside the body cavity;(b) first and second ; support membersSVG {EMBED HERE} 0.140.56 disposed through the elongate component;
(c) a first movable segmented robotic arm operably coupled to the first support member, the first movable segmented robotic arm comprising:(i) a first operational component operably coupled to the first movable segmented robotic arm; and
(ii) at least one first arm motor associated with the first movable segmented robotic arm; and
(d) a second movable segmented robotic arm operably coupled to the second support member, the second movable segmented robotic arm comprising:(i) a second operational component operably coupled to the second movable segmented robotic arm; and
(ii) at least one second arm motor associated with the second movable segmented robotic arm.
2. (New) The robotic surgical device of claim 1, wherein the support member comprises a first support member and a second support member.
3. (New) The robotic surgical device of claim 2, wherein the first movable segmented robotic arm is operably coupled to the first support member, and the second movable segmented robotic arm is operably coupled to the second support member.
4. (New) The robotic surgical device of claim 1, wherein the robotic device may be assembled within the body cavity of the patient.
5. (New) The robotic surgical device of claim 1, wherein the elongate component is further configured to receive at least one connection component, and further comprising an external controller configured to be positioned outside the cavity of the patient, wherein the external controller is operably coupled to the first connection component.
6. (New) The robotic surgical device of claim 1, wherein each of the first operational component and the second operational component are chosen from a group consisting of a grasping component, a cauterizing component, a suturing component, an imaging component, an operational arm component, a sensor component, and a lighting component.
7. (New) The robotic surgical device of claim 1, wherein the at least one first arm motor is configured for operation, rotation or movement of at least one of the first segmented arm and the first operational component.
8. (New) The robotic surgical device of claim 1, wherein the at least one second arm motor is configured for operation, rotation or movement of at least one of the second segmented arm and the second operational component.
9. (New) The robotic surgical device of claim 1, wherein the first and second operational components are rotatable relative to the first and second segmented arms.
10. (New) The robotic surgical device of claim 1, wherein the first and second segmented arms are capable of jointed movement.
11. (New) The robotic surgical device of claim 1, further comprising one or more external support components operably coupled to the elongate component.
12. (New) A robotic surgical system, comprising:
a) an elongate component configured to be at least partially positionable within a cavity of a patient through an incision of the patient, the elongate component having a support member disposed therewithin; and b) a robotic device sized to be positionable completely within the cavity of the patient, the device comprising:
i) a first robotic arm operably coupled to the support member, the first robotic arm comprising a first operational component operably coupled to the first robotic arm;
ii) a second robotic arm operably coupled to the support member, the second robotic arm comprising a second operational component operably coupled to the second robotic arm; and iii) at least one actuator housed within the robotic device.
13. (New) The robotic surgical device of claim 12, wherein the support member comprises a first support member and a second support member, and wherein the first movable segmented robotic arm is operably coupled to the first support member, and the second movable segmented robotic arm is operably coupled to the second support member.
14. (New) A robotic surgical system, comprising:a) an elongate component configured to be positionable through an incision of a patient such that a distal portion of the elongate component is disposed within a cavity of the patient and a proximal portion of the elongate component is disposed outside the cavity;
b) a support member disposed through the elongate component; and
c) a robotic device sized to be positionable completely within the cavity of the patient, the device comprising:
i) a first robotic arm operably coupled to the support member, the first robotic arm comprising a first operational component operably coupled to the first robotic arm;
ii) a second robotic arm operably coupled to the support member, the second robotic arm comprising a second operational component operably coupled to the second robotic arm; and iii) at least one actuator housed within the robotic device.
15. (New) The robotic surgical device of claim 14, wherein the support member comprises a first support member and a second support member.
16. (New) The robotic surgical device of claim 15, wherein the first movable segmented robotic arm is operably coupled to the first support member, and the second movable segmented robotic arm is operably coupled to the second support member.
17. (New) The robotic surgical system of claim 14, wherein the at least one actuator is capable of operation, rotation or movement of at least one of the first robotic arm, the second robotic arm, the first operational component, and the second operational component.
18. (New) The robotic surgical system of claim 14, wherein each of the first and second operational components are chosen from a group consisting of a grasping component, a cauterizing component, a suturing component, an imaging component, an operational arm component, a sensor component, and a lighting component.
19. (New) The robotic surgical system of claim 14, wherein the robotic device is assembleable within the body cavity of the patient.
20. (New) The robotic surgical system of claim 14, further comprising a first connection component disposed within the elongate component, the first connection component being operably coupled at a distal end to the robotic device.
